proposal.label: needs more info
proposal.comment: Thanks — we can’t reproduce the crash from the information given. Please attach the complete crash output (stderr) or a stack/backtrace produced when DuckDB segfaults, and confirm the exact DuckDB build you used (release tag or commit hash and how it was installed — e.g. pip wheel, binary download, or built from source). Also provide the OS and CPU architecture (e.g. Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64) and whether the crash reproduces on the latest DuckDB release. With those details we can run an equivalent binary and collect a debugger trace.
proposal.rationale: The SQL reproducer is complete, but a crashing segfault requires the exact DuckDB build/binary and the crash stderr/stack trace plus OS/CPU to reproduce and debug. Without the build identifier and crash output, the failure cannot be followed.
